sink.description: String concatenation into SQL query passed to Db.exec

flow.description: User input read from query parameter
Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

finding.description: User-controlled input from HTTP query parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL query string without parameterization.
finding.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

results.evidence_notes: False positive: the source value is validated by parseInt before concatenation, constraining it to numeric values only. The parseInt call at line 11 ensures only numeric values reach the query. While parameterization is still preferred, this is not exploitable.
